title: triaristella dressleri
intro: Triaristella dressleri, commonly known as the 'Golden Star' plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system.
